# R-elitecyc weight and momentum-velocity norms, 10k-800k

Run: `uv run --with numpy python weight_norms.py <steps...>` (checkpoints in Models/). |W| = L2 norm of the group's weights; |v| = L2 norm of its SGD momentum velocity (v = 0.9 v + clipped loss gradient; weight decay is decoupled and not in v or in gNorm, ChessTrainer.swift ~4385).
